streams.label: dead policy: 0.0 x 6
streams.message: lerobot_local: Policy emitted near-zero actions (max abs < 0.001) for 10 consecutive steps: the robot will not move. This usually means the observation never reached the model -- check the embodiment's obs_rename / camera keys and that observation.state is populated.

streams.label: poisoned: nan x 6
streams.message: lerobot_local: Policy emitted a non-finite action (max abs = nan): the robot will not move. This is not the near-zero case -- a non-finite action is refused by the simulation and hardware backends rather than applied, so the obs_rename / camera keys are not implicated. Check the checkpoint's normalization statistics (a zero divisor yields inf/nan) and whether any observation value is itself non-finite.
